# FINANCIALS — 2026-W46 (week to 2026-11-14)

## Coverage changes
Twenty-four BANKS initiations published 8–Nov to 14‑Nov, plus a BBCA update triggered by the IHSG reweight [BBCA](coverage/companies/BBCA.JK/report.md). The batch is 16 SELL, 5 REDUCE, 2 BUY, 1 ADD – the 9‑Nov–13‑Nov stretch was eight SELLs in a row, reflecting the held `balance_of_payments_pressure` / CAUTIOUS regime’s AVOID tilt on IDR‑rate‑sensitive names [deck macro]. Tier‑3 banks (BINA, BSIM, BSWD) priced at deep discounts to tangible book (0.2–0.5×). No MULTIFINANCE, INSURANCE, CAPITAL_MARKETS or FINANCIAL_HOLDCOS name is published; the queue holds sixty‑four initiations (20 FINANCIAL_HOLDCOS, 19 INSURANCE, 13 MULTIFINANCE, 6 CAPITAL_MARKETS, 6 BANKS).

## Deck moves
Macro deck’s usd_idr spot marked to Rp18,190/USD (13‑Nov close), DXY spot to 103.233 [deck macro][S7,S8] — both inside the `CAUTIOUS`‑regime band; no marker tripped. Forward path (usd_idr FY2027E 18,350, DXY 102.25, BI‑Rate 5.75%, CPI 3.28%, GDP 5.29%) held 7‑Nov with AVOID tilt on IDR‑rate‑sensitive names – the same tilt feeding every bank NIM [deck macro]. No macro variable changed status or basis.

## Material news
Kredit Murah 2027 allocation raised to Rp386.9tn (from Rp360tn), with Rp36.6tn left for 2026 [triage d27cadde38069a41]. 9% subsidised loan rate for farmers (Danantara) and Rp394‑tn total budget [1cb6138deb7fc57e][0b979abacb2b6cb3]. BBCA’s IHSG weight rises from 9.75% to 10.38% after 296 HSC names excluded; BBRI weight also climbs [d55c6afee3d1ccc8]. Rights‑issue approvals: BRIS 6.8bn shares (12‑Nov) [393c2be94b7f69b7][1a3a87ae26f32aa9]; BINA Rp50bn private placement [1471db1f0975a24b]; BMAS USD341m loan from parent [41ce3ea7f7860b10]. KB Bank (BBKP) faces potential co‑op-consortium buyout (Minister Kemenkop, not yet tendered) [a8c46fc3e294a6fe]. BBRI results: Q3‑2026 profit Rp48.2tn (+16.8% y/y).

## What to watch
KB Bank (BBKP) – whether the co‑op‑consortium bid materialises; if not, stock holds 40% float‑discount to book. BRIS rights‑issue terms and funding‑cost effect within AVOID‑tilt frame. PNBN, BBTN, BJBR drafts parked pending sign‑off (BJBR already ADD). Macro weekly direction check (14‑Nov DXY/usd_idr/oil) and any FOMC‑outcome catch‑up (28–29‑Oct meeting still `UNVERIFIED`). Coverage queue: INSURANCE names start drafting (BNLI, GEMS already queued).
